item_short_desc: Rothco's Tactical Raid Vest combines functionality and durability, making it ideal for law enforcement and public safety professionals. With 12 front snap and hook & loop pouches, including 4 detachable pockets, you can quickly access gear like radios and other essentials. Three rear pouches provide extra storage, while a padded back ensures comfort during long shifts. The vest features adjustable side straps for a customized fit and a front zipper for easy on and off.
description: Rothco's Tactical Raid Vest combines functionality and durability, making it ideal for law enforcement and public safety professionals. With 12 front snap and hook & loop pouches, including 4 detachable pockets, you can quickly access gear like radios and other essentials. Three rear pouches provide extra storage, while a padded back ensures comfort during long shifts. The vest features adjustable side straps for a customized fit and a front zipper for easy on and off. A loop panel on the upper section accommodates additional patches, and 2 blank blackout hook-back patches are included for customization. Built with rugged materials, this vest is designed to endure demanding environments.
